The study found that the balance between Von Willebrand Factor (VWF) and ADAMTS13 is severely disrupted in patients with severe COVID-19 infection
The researchers took and examined blood samples from patients with Covid-19 in the Beaumont Hospital Intensive Care Unit in Dublin
The researchers then compared the blood of COVID-19 patients with non-COVID patients
The researchers also identified other changes in the proteins that caused a drop in the ADAMTS13
